name: Rowdy Research
oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature that attacked this turn.
Draw three cards.
blocked_sentences: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature that attacked this turn.

needs.what: a card-level cost_reduction shape that counts every creature (any controller) that attacked this turn, read from the turn ledger's attacker oids rather than the board -- e.g. a cost_reduction key taking a value expression such as attackers_this_turn over all players, or attacked_this_turn added to cost_reduction_filter_keys with the count reading the ledger so attackers that died or left still count
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction accepts only amount/count/greatest_count/total_power/total_mana_value/greatest_mana_value; count's filter keys have 'attacking' (only creatures still attacking now, so zero in a postcombat main phase and missing attackers that died) but not 'attacked_this_turn', and the value 'attackers_this_turn' exists only in value_keys, which cost_reduction cannot read
